home.title: Leutheria — Everyday essentials for businesses and homes across Europe
home.description: Leutheria is a French e-commerce company selling everyday essentials online to businesses and households across Europe. Manufacturers, become a supplier.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.description: A question, a partnership or a product to propose? Contact the Leutheria team; manufacturers can write to sourcing@leutheria.co.

hero.title: Everyday essentials for businesses and homes.
hero.lead: Founded in Paris in 2020, Leutheria sells everyday essentials online to businesses and households across Europe. We select each product for quality and consistency, and work directly with the manufacturers who make them.

offer.title: What we sell
offer.lead: Three themes, one standard: products people reorder without a second thought.

retail.title: Retail & point of sale
retail.body: Consumables that keep counters, tills and card terminals running, day after day, in shops and businesses.

kitchen.title: Kitchen & catering
kitchen.body: Equipment for professional and home kitchens, chosen to hold up through daily service.

office.title: Office & business
office.body: The supplies offices go through every day: dependable references customers can standardise on.

approach.title: Why Leutheria
approach.lead: A small, independent team that knows its products and the people who make them.

direct.title: Direct relationships
direct.body: We work directly with manufacturers. You talk to the people who make the decisions, not to a chain of intermediaries.

standard.title: Quality before price
standard.body: We select on quality and consistency, not on unit price alone, so customers get the same product every time they reorder.

europe.title: Selling across Europe
europe.body: A French company registered in Paris since 2020, selling online to customers throughout Europe.

company.title: The company
company.lead: Leutheria is a French company, registered in Paris and trading since 2020.
company.formValue: SARL registered with the {city} Trade and Companies Register

cta.title: Are you a manufacturer?
cta.body: If your products fit these themes and you are looking for a reliable partner in Europe, write to us. We read every proposal and come back to you quickly.

Contact.title: Contact us
Contact.lead: A question, a partnership or a product to propose? Send us a message and we will come back to you quickly. Manufacturers can also write directly to <mail>{sourcingEmail}</mail>.
Contact.success: Thanks, your message is on its way. We will get back to you shortly.
Contact.error: Sending failed. Please try again, or write to us directly at {email}.
Contact.privacyNotice: The details you enter are used only to answer your request. They are delivered through our form provider, Web3Forms, and are never sold. Learn more in our <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.
Contact.unconfigured: The form is not configured yet. In the meantime, write to us directly:

errors.tooShort: Please tell us a little more about your request.

Legal.title: Legal notice
Legal.lead: Legal information about leutheria.co, published in accordance with French Act No. 2004-575 of 21 June 2004 on confidence in the digital economy.

host.title: Hosting
host.cdn: Pages are delivered through Vercel’s edge network, which acts as the site’s content delivery network (CDN): copies of the pages are cached on Vercel servers close to visitors.

dns.title: Domain name
dns.body: The DNS zone of leutheria.co is managed by {name}, {address}, {country} — {url}. Cloudflare only resolves the domain name: it neither hosts nor relays the site’s pages.

intellectualProperty.title: Intellectual property
intellectualProperty.body: Every element making up this site — text, images, logos, trade marks, structure and code — is protected by copyright and trade mark law. Any reproduction, representation, adaptation or exploitation, in whole or in part, without the prior written consent of {company}, is prohibited.

terms.title: Terms of sale
terms.body: {company} sells its products online through marketplaces, under the terms shown on each marketplace at the time of order. Business customers who buy directly from {company} receive its terms and conditions of sale with each quote.

liability.title: Liability
liability.body: {company} strives to keep the information published on this site accurate and up to date, without being able to guarantee that it is exhaustive. The site may link to third-party sites whose content is not the responsibility of {company}.

personalData.title: Personal data and cookies
personalData.body: How {company} processes personal data is explained in the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>. The only cookie the site sets is described on the <cookies>cookies page</cookies>.

Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.lead: What personal data leutheria.co collects, why, who receives it and how long it is kept. The site has no customer account and no newsletter: the contact form is the only place where you hand over data, and visits are counted without cookies.

controller.title: Data controller
controller.body: The controller of the processing described below is {legalName}, {legalForm} with registered office at {address}, registered with the {rcsCity} Trade and Companies Register under number {siren}.
controller.contact: For any question about your data, write to <mailto>{email}</mailto>.

contactForm.title: Contact form
contactForm.intro: When you send a message through the <contact>contact form</contact>:
contactForm.data: Your name, email address and message. {formProvider}, which receives the form, also sees your IP address as part of the request.
contactForm.purpose: Answering your message and, where relevant, preparing and following up a quote.
contactForm.legalBasis: The legitimate interest of {company} in answering the people who contact it (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR) and, when you ask for a quote, steps taken at your request before entering into a contract (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR).
contactForm.recipients: The {company} staff handling your request; <form>{formProvider}</form>, which receives the form from your browser and forwards it by email; the anti-spam services CleanTalk and Akismet, to which {formProvider} may pass your IP address and email address; <mail>{mailProvider}</mail>, which hosts the {company} mailbox the message lands in. {formProvider} and {mailProvider} act as processors.
contactForm.retention: Three years from the last exchange with you, then deleted. If the exchange leads to an order, the related commercial documents are kept for the periods required by commercial and tax law.
contactForm.providerNote: {formProvider} stores submissions in a database hosted on Amazon Web Services (AWS) and deletes them automatically at most three years after they are sent, independently of the retention period above. See <policy>its privacy policy</policy>.

hosting.title: Hosting logs
hosting.intro: Like any web host, {host} records technical data each time a page of the site is requested, whether or not you use the form.
hosting.data: IP address, browser user agent, requested URL, date and time, and the status of the response.
hosting.purpose: Delivering the site, keeping it secure and diagnosing errors.
hosting.legalBasis: The legitimate interest of {company} in running a secure and available website (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR).
hosting.recipients: <hostLink>{host}</hostLink>, the site’s hosting provider, acting as processor.
hosting.retention: Vercel keeps runtime logs for at most 30 days, depending on the hosting plan. It may keep some security data longer under <policy>its own privacy policy</policy>.

audience.title: Audience measurement
audience.intro: Visits to the site are counted with {analytics}, an open-source tool that {analyticsOperator} hosts itself. It sets no cookie and stores nothing in your browser.
audience.data: Pages viewed, the site you came from, device type, browser, operating system, language, screen size, and the country and city derived from your IP address. The IP address is also used to tell visits apart, then it is not kept.
audience.purpose: Knowing how many people visit the site and which pages they read, to improve it.
audience.legalBasis: The legitimate interest of {company} in knowing how its website is used (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR). The tracker stores nothing in your browser, but before each measurement it reads one local-storage setting, umami.disabled, which turns measurement off when set. {company} relies on the consent exemption the CNIL grants to audience measurement that only produces anonymous statistics for the site’s publisher (Article 82 of the French Data Protection Act), which is why no consent is asked.
audience.recipients: <umami>{analyticsOperator}</umami>, which runs the {analytics} instance on its own server in France (OVH), acting as processor; {proxy}, through which requests to {analyticsHost} pass on their way to that server, acting as processor. Nothing is sent to any other third party.
audience.retention: Statistics kept for as long as the site exists, without IP addresses or any data that identifies you directly.

transfers.title: Transfers outside the European Union
transfers.body: {host}, {mailProvider} and {proxy}, through which the audience measurement passes, may process data in the United States; these transfers rely on the EU–US Data Privacy Framework for companies certified under it, and otherwise on the standard contractual clauses adopted by the European Commission. {formProvider}, which operates from India and hosts its data on AWS in the United States, frames transfers out of the European Union with the European Commission’s standard contractual clauses, as set out in its data processing agreement.
transfers.check: A company’s certification can be checked on <dpf>dataprivacyframework.gov</dpf>.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.intro: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the French Data Protection Act, you have the right to:
rights.access: Access — find out whether data about you is processed and get a copy of it;
rights.rectification: Rectification — have inaccurate or incomplete data corrected;
rights.erasure: Erasure — have your data deleted, unless it must be kept to meet a legal obligation;
rights.restriction: Restriction — have the processing of your data temporarily frozen;
rights.objection: Objection — object at any time, on grounds relating to your situation, to processing based on legitimate interest;
rights.portability: Portability — receive the data you provided in a structured, commonly used format, or have it sent to another organisation, when the processing is based on steps taken at your request before a contract;
rights.postMortem: Instructions after death — set instructions on how your data should be kept, erased or communicated after your death (Article 85 of the French Data Protection Act).
rights.exercise: To exercise these rights, write to <mailto>{email}</mailto>. {company} answers within one month; that period can be extended by two months for complex requests, in which case you will be told why. Proof of identity may only be requested if there is reasonable doubt about who is making the request.

complaint.title: Complaints
complaint.body: If you believe your rights are not being respected, you can lodge a complaint with the CNIL, the French data protection authority: <cnil>cnil.fr/fr/plaintes</cnil>.

security.title: Security and data breaches
security.body: The site is served over HTTPS only, and the form is sent to {formProvider} over an encrypted connection. Access to the mailbox that receives messages is limited to the people who handle requests.
security.breach: If a personal data breach is likely to put your rights at risk, {company} notifies the CNIL within 72 hours of becoming aware of it and, if the risk is high, informs you directly without undue delay.

noSale.title: No sale of data
noSale.body: {company} does not sell your data, does not rent it out and does not use it for advertising. No automated decision or profiling is based on it.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: This policy changes when the site or its providers change. The date at the top of the page shows the current version; cookies are described on the <cookies>cookies page</cookies>.

Cookies.title: Cookies
Cookies.lead: What the site stores in your browser, and why it shows no consent banner.

summary.title: In short
summary.body: leutheria.co sets a single cookie, to keep the language you chose. It sets no analytics, advertising or social-media cookie and loads no advertising tracker: visits are counted without cookies (see the privacy policy).

list.title: Cookies used
list.caption: Cookies set by leutheria.co
list.name: Name

nextLocale.purpose: Keeps the language you chose (English or French) while you browse, so the site does not switch back to your browser’s language.
nextLocale.duration: Session — deleted when you close your browser

list.note: It is only set when you switch language, or when the language of the page you open differs from your browser’s. It contains nothing but the language code (en or fr).

exempt.title: No consent required
exempt.body: This cookie is strictly necessary to provide the service you asked for: the site in your language. Under Article 82 of the French Data Protection Act and the CNIL’s guidelines, it is exempt from consent, which is why the site shows no cookie banner.

thirdParties.title: Third-party services
thirdParties.body: Fonts are served from leutheria.co itself, and the pages embed no video, map or social-media widget. Every page loads the {analytics} audience-measurement script from {analyticsHost}, run by {analyticsOperator}: it sets no cookie and only reads one local-storage setting, umami.disabled, which turns it off. The contact form only contacts {formProvider} when you send a message. Both are described in the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.

manage.title: Managing cookies
manage.body: You can view and delete cookies at any time in your browser’s settings. Blocking this cookie does not break the site: it then follows your browser’s language.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.body: The page you are looking for does not exist or has been moved.

Footer.tagline: A better world for your company. Everyday essentials for businesses and homes across Europe, selected for quality and consistency.
